answer: Proof-of-stake consensus functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to validate transactions. Much like the immense pressure required to compress sediment into shale or basalt within a mountain summit, the cost of an attack is tied to the financial stake held. By tethering identity to verifiable economic commitment rather than computational volume, an attacker is forced to absorb the catastrophic loss of their own capital to dilute the network integrity.
